description: The servers an agent may reach, by kind (1.7.10). Empty here: the harness ships none. The company lists its own in the knowledge base, company/tools/servers.json, copied to servers.company.json by `harness company sync`: {"servers": {alias: {"kind": <a kind of .harness/kinds/>, "env": dev|ist|qat|prod, "auth": <a way in the kind names>, <the kind's fields: host, port, ...>, "label": <words for people>, "rules": <optional, as in tools.json>}}}. An alias is lower case letters, digits and -. The person's identities, and servers of their own, are kept in .harness/.env by Get ready, never here. Each server becomes a system of tools.json for the gate.
